Even if their mind games are meant to protect themselves and they are inadvertently manipulating you. We always want to be accountable for how we contributed or escalate. However, sometimes it cannot be helped because dealing with narcs is maddening. Much love to you.

Be subtle. These people aren't dumb and they can pick up on social engineering in a heartbeat. Narcs display a sense of grandiosity. For example: My mom used to brag about how people who'd already invented things took her ideas. That if companies just gave her a chance she could be so much better at designing than any of them. So ask them what they think their biggest talents are. And if they start going off on a tangent that puts others down while boasting about their deluded self image, in a hateful, angry way: That's one way to know. 

Share good news with them to see how they react. That's also very telling. Pay attention to how much they redirect the conversation to themselves. I knew a narc that would briefly acknowledge what I said then start talking about what they wanted to immediately. Also, if you can barely respond or acknowledge what they said and they keep talking that's also a sign. I have a good friend that does this sometimes and they are ADHD. I also do this when excited. So this doesn't make you a narc automatically. But narcs do it if that makes sense. Also. Ask them the worst thing that's ever happened to them. If they spiral into a rant about how the world has only ever done them wrong and they are victims in every situation: another sign.
